title: CARETS: A Consistency And Robustness Evaluative Test Suite for VQA

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model self-consistency and comprehensive accuracy on paired instances with text perturbations, including rephrasing, changed logical argument order, ontological variations, negation, and antonym substitutions to test reliance on linguistic shortcuts.

Measuring model invariance when irrelevant background regions in the image are obscured using techniques like Gaussian blurring, pixel masking, and bounding-box cropping to test over-reliance on spurious visual context.

Analyzing model response rates and performance across different question formats (e.g., binary vs. multi-choice, conjunctive vs. disjunctive) to detect defaults like an algorithmic 'yes' bias or sensitivity to the number of answer choices.
